{{Top|leg}}
A '''gartro egg omelet''' was a dish made from [[gartro]] [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] and [[jerba cheese]]. They were served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] for 7.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] where fillings of either diced [[Gornt/Legends|gornt]], diced [[Roba/Legends|roba]], [[Felucian glasscap mushroom]]s, [[Ferroan spinach]], [[Bellassan pepper/Legends|Bellassan peppers]], [[Ojomian onion]]s, [[Topato/Legends|topatoes]] or [[Calarantrum root/Legends|calarantrum]] root were available for an extra 0.5 credits.
